text:
Mina: heads-up — the nightly k6 replay started ~5m ago and we're seeing a 99th percentile spike in the tokenization path, tail latency ≈ 3x vs yesterday. k6 run id: replay-20260317-42. Thoughts on a bailout plan? :eyes:
Sam: wfm. Can you paste the k6 command and the scenario source? Also what's the baseline commit SHA?
Mina: command: `k6 run --vus 400 --duration 60m --out json=out.json script.js`
scenario: replay from s3 `s3://replays/2026-03-16-replay.json`
baseline sha: a1b2c3d, current sha: a1b2c3e
Jess: @Mina please attach the flamegraph link when available. If it's KV cache or mem growth, we should run a quick heap/alloc profile. Prefer: `perf-bot profile start replay-42 --duration 3m`
perf-bot: perf-bot automated check: initial smoke indicates increased p99 on `svc-model-1` and CPU steal on g4dn nodes. Uploading logs to https://internal/soak/replay-42/logs (processing...)
Ryan: on infra — I can spin up an extra pool of 4 nodes in us-west-2 for burst isolation. @Sam if we rerun, pin `BATCH_SIZE=8` and `KV_CACHE=true` to compare changes.
Sam: ack. Also add `--ramp 60s` to avoid injection spikes. Quick profiling checklist: 1) capture flamegraph, 2) heap snapshot, 3) collect iostat/disk latency, 4) trace kv-cache hit rate + KV eviction events.
Mina: starting rerun now with pinned env and ramp. Will upload flamegraph + out.json in ~10m. If tail persists we'll consider canary fallback to quantized-variant (lower perf but more stable).
Jess: can we also add a temporary route-level timeout at 5s so slow requests fail fast and don't backlog worker queues? That should limit cascading pressure.
Ryan: added LB rule: `proxy.timeout.route /v1/generate 5s` — watching connection queues and backlog.
Mina: thanks — action items: @Sam run the profiling checklist and upload artifacts to the replay folder, @Jess prepare a rollback/canary plan for the quantized variant (including metric gates), @Ryan keep the extra pool up for 30m and report scale metrics. I'll post final verdict once artifacts land. :thumbsup:
